name: kg_finding_resolve
description: Mark a kg_maintenance_finding as executed. Call this AFTER the corresponding KG mutation succeeded (or after deciding the finding requires no KG change). Records action + notes in execution_notes for audit. Always pass a non-empty `reason`.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: One of: merge_nodes / rename_label / update_node_field / delete_edge / no_action / acknowledged. Goes into execution_notes.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.description: Free-form notes (revision_log_id of the mutation, etc.).

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the finding is now resolved.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_finding_resolve:
- finding_id (required)
- action (optional): the op that was applied
- notes (optional): any details
- reason (required)
